description: Controlled 3-arm A/B experiment evaluating Ode's new register allocation (bottom-up exact keeps + dead parameter reclamation + zero silent spills with explicit stack var) and interactive fast-fail + TRY_HARDER rescue across 6 orthogonal tasks (incl. pure HL BLAKE3 1-block and 4-way SIMD), 6 frontier models, and 2 targets (216 cells: 72 paired cells/arm).
